About the Scholarship

EMMIR is the first African-European-Asian Erasmus Mundus master in migration studies, run by eight partner institutions from Germany to Ghana, Uganda, South Africa and India. Applications for Edition 14 (2027-2029) are open now: scholarship and non-fee-paying places close on 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET, while fee-paying self-funded applications run until 15 July 2027.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EMMIR is the first African-European-Asian Erasmus Mundus master in migration studies, run by eight partner institutions from Germany to Ghana, Uganda, South Africa and India. Applications for Edition 14 (2027-2029) are open now: scholarship and non-fee-paying places close on 20 December 2026 at 23:59 CET, while fee-paying self-funded applications run until 15 July 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Eight institutions across Europe, Africa and Asia with EU funding renewed for five years
  • Two-tier deadline: 20 December 2026 for funded places, 15 July 2027 self-funded
  • EUR 1,400 monthly scholarship plus travel and insurance support
  • Edition 14 cohort starts in September 2027

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's graduates in social sciences, history, cultural studies, education, law, economics, development or journalism, with a minimum C+ final grade and documented migration-studies knowledge; the last degree should not be older than five years without justification.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus+ scholarship of EUR 1,400 per month for 24 months for selected scholarship holders.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the EMMIR application platform by 20 December 2026 (23:59 CET) for funded consideration; TOEFL/IELTS documentation uses Oldenburg's DI code 3556. Key deadline information: 20 December 2026 (23:59 CET) for Erasmus Mundus scholarships and non-fee-paying places; fee-paying self-funded until 15 July 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EMMIR Consortium (University of Oldenburg)

The EMMIR consortium is coordinated from the Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg and delivers the Erasmus Mundus master in Migration and Intercultural Relations with partners across Europe, Africa and Asia.

Official website: https://www.emmir.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 20 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
